name: Aizawa Yukito
source:
The protagonist of this story. A second-year student at Seio Academy. He is serious and good at studying, but is also shy. He is a childhood friend of [url=/c3501]Otoha[/url] and has feelings for her. He also harbors feelings for his stepsister, [url=/c3502]Suzuka[/url], that go beyond those of a brother.
